subject: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor Rezoning
overview: The City Council and the Community Development Board held a joint public hearing on proposed zoning amendments establishing the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District. Following presentations, extensive member discussion, and public testimony concerning building heights, student housing, and district boundaries, both bodies voted to continue the hearing to June 11, 2026.

items.title: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District Rezoning (Hearing 26-093)
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to June 11, 2026, following a staff and consultant presentation on three proposed mixed-use sub-districts and extensive debate over building heights, district boundaries, lodger parking mandates, and private student housing.
